newsitem.title: FRANCE: Michelin in, Credit Local out of broker's list.
newsitem.headline: Michelin in, Credit Local out of broker's list.

text.p: Brokerage Cheuvreux de Virieu has taken Credit Local de France out of its list of recommended stocks, replacing it with Michelin, dealers said on Tuesday.
The decision is aimed at increasing the weight of cyclical stocks in the list, they said.

The decision to include Michelin in the list of recommended stocks assumes an upturn in the French economy in 1997 and follows the release of first half results showing restructuring efforts were beginning to have a positive impact. Cheuvreux had previously issued a buy recommendation on the stock.
Cheuvreux is holding its buy recommendation on Credit Local de France but the French bank is facing budget constraints affecting regional governments.
Michelin gained 2.58 percent to 266.80 francs in a volume of 967,000 shares while Credit Local lost 1.96 percent to 436.30 francs in a volume of 43,000 shares around 1000 GMT.
